sources.use: Context for provisional carbon inputs only: typical composite tensile modulus 134 GPa and compressive strength 1450 MPa, epoxy at 130 C, normalized to 60% fiber volume. I008 comparison still uses E=135 GPa and density=1600 kg/m3; this is not a tube laminate specification.
Steel density approximately 7850 kg/m3 and modulus approximately 200 GPa for screening mass/stiffness.
355 MPa minimum yield for specified sheet product. Applied as a nominal plate/formed-sleeve screen; no welded assembly, formed box or machined-pin rating is established.

provenance: Primary sources carried byte-for-byte in the pinned I014 sources record; no vendor or expert contact. New dimensions and force idealizations are explicit unqualified design assumptions.
